# Fictional test documents

Every file in this folder is **invented for automated tests**. The names,
parties, case numbers and text are fictional and do not describe any real
person, organisation or matter.

They are generated by `server/scripts/make_document_fixtures.py` from
`server/tests/document_fixtures.py`; `server/tests/test_extractors.py` checks
that these copies still match the generator.

| File | Used to check |
| --- | --- |
| `fictional-petition-3-pages.pdf` | text extracted page by page, with the right page numbers |
| `fictional-scan-no-text.pdf` | a PDF without a text layer fails with a visible reason |
| `fictional-notes.txt` | plain text, split into parts without page numbers |
